text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, sorry for the trouble.
I was being careless.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't do anything like that anymore, so you can put your mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now then, since the pain has subsided,
how about we head back and continue training?
choice_data_list: Let's rest up, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now then, since the pain has subsided,
how about we head back and continue training?
choice_data_list: Let's rest up, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear me... I'd think moving around a little bit
wouldn't hurt, though."
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you're fully healed before going all out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see, so you're saying there's always a chance something could go wrong.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so, Trainer,
I guess I'll take a breather.

Though she seemed somewhat reluctant,
Wonder Acute accepted our proposal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as lively as ever,
aren't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then, let's get right on our way.

And so,
we resumed our training, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The pain's started up again a bit...
Guess I pushed myself too hard, huh.

Afterward, at Wonder Acute's suggestion,
we decided to take a break from training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then, let's get right on our way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah.
This much shouldn't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'll just keep going like this
and get back in shape~."

Afterward, Wonder Acute continued to
work hard on her training at her own pace.
